snippet.title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis – Pre-order Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 on February 12, 2027! Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/tomb-raider-legacy-of-atlantis-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is a stunning reimagining of Lara Croft's iconic 1996 debut adventure, rebuilt from the ground up for a new generation. In this action-adventure, players step into the boots of the legendary adventurer as she embarks on a globe-trotting quest to track down the broken pieces of the Scion—an artifact of immeasurable power.
 
From the lush jungles of Peru and ancient ruins of Greece to the treacherous tombs of Egypt, players will navigate deadly traps, face lethal predators, and master Lara's signature acrobatic abilities and dual pistols to overcome every challenge in their path.

#NintendoDirect #TombRaider

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
